name: Invisible Apartment 2
source:
Invisible Apartment 2 is the next chapter of the Invisible Apartment series of cyberpunk visual novels. Set in a future where surveillance and hacking are part of every day life, it revolves around human relations, their dreams and how to lead a normal life.

[From [url=http://milankazarka.itch.io/invisible-apartment-2]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《隐形公寓2》是赛博朋克视觉小说《隐形公寓》系列的下一章。故事背景设定在监控和黑客攻击成为日常生活一部分的未来，围绕人际关系、他们的梦想以及如何过上正常的生活。

[来自[url=http://milankazarka.itch.io/invisible-apartment-2]Itch.io[/url]]
